title: Types prefixed or absolute
description: Outside the @context, every @type value is a compact IRI written with a prefix, or an absolute IRI: it has a colon before any slash. A bare name such as Thing would be resolved against the @base, naming a class nobody defined, without an error from any processor. Whether the prefix is declared is a separate expectation.
summary: Every `@type` value is a prefixed or absolute IRI, never a bare name

errorMessage.pattern: a @type is a compact IRI with a prefix, or an absolute IRI, not a bare name
